mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id AS courseId, type, content, options, answer, is_llm_generated AS isLlmGenerated, asr_audio_url AS asrAudioUrl, create_time AS createTime FROM tb_question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_question (course_id, type, content, options, answer, is_llm_generated, create_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{options}, #{answer}, #{isLlmGenerated}, NOW())
